10 COMPRESSION METHODS. 📦

Gzip: safe default.
Zstd: speed + ratio.
Snappy: fast block compression.
Brotli: strong for web text.
LZ4: speed first.
DEFLATE: LZ77 + Huffman.
Bzip2: smaller, slower.
XZ/LZMA: high ratio, higher resource cost.
Lossy images: smaller by discarding detail.
Delta encoding: store changes instead of values.

Smaller isn't automatically better.

Choose the trade-off your workload actually needs.

This 15-minute AI agent workflow can help run parts of your business for you:

(even if you are non-technical)

1. Open ChatGPT.

2. Create a Project called “My AI Assistant.”

3. Upload:
 your FAQs
  services/products
  SOPs
  brand voice notes
  pricing sheet
  sales scripts

4. Tell ChatGPT:
 “You are my AI operations assistant.”

5. Add instructions like:
 answer customer questions
  write emails
  draft proposals
  organize ideas
  summarize meetings
